messages:
sam: Heads-up — Trident private deploy tonight 02:00–03:00 UTC. Primary goals: config rollout, model-serving bump to v1.3.2, and a quick smoke run. Who's available for the window?

irene: I can run smoke and follow up on errors. I’ll be online at 01:45 UTC. Planning to run quick checks against staging mirror first. :thumbsup:

kai: I’ll own the model-serving side. Plan: pin to v1.3.2, disable autoscale during rollout, and keep older replicas for 10m. I’ll post exact k8s commands before start.

matt: I can coordinate the overall orchestration and trigger the deploy-bot. Will hold rollback steps ready.

ops-elaine: I’ll monitor network, LB, and DB metrics. Have alerted infra on-call for a 02:00 spike watch.

sam: Quick smoke checklist (short run):
```
# health endpoints
curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' https://trident.private.redwood/api/health | jq .status
# inference sanity
python infra/tests/smoke/run_smoke.py --customer trident --mode quick
# latencies
curl -s https://trident.private.redwood/api/ping | jq .latency_ms
```

irene: Re: smoke — I’ll run the python script and paste results to this thread. If any test fails, we pause and triage.

kai: Note on model KV cache — we'll snapshot current cache before restart. Command I’ll run: `kubectl rollout pause deploy/model-svc && kubectl set image deploy/model-svc model=image:v1.3.2` then resume after health ok.

matt: Deploy-bot, please schedule the job to start at 02:05 UTC (give us a 5m buffer after window open).

deploy-bot: scheduled job: trident-deploy at 1705123500 by matt. Estimated runtime 8m.

sam: Rollback plan (short):
- If smoke fails or error rate > 2% for 5m, trigger rollback.
- Rollback steps: `kubectl set image deploy/model-svc model=image:v1.3.1` then remove new routing rules.
- DB: no destructive migration in this window; feature flag toggle is the safe path.

ops-elaine: I’ll keep Grafana and p99/err-rate windows open. Slack alert if p95 latency > 800ms.

irene: Agree on criteria. I’ll also check sample outputs for regression (quick eval set).

kai: I’ll keep a local copy of model weights and the previous image on standby in case of immediate rollback.

matt: If everything looks green, we’ll promote to dedicated capacity after 30m stabilization. If not, we rollback and file a follow-up.

sam: Thanks — last confirmations: @kai you on-deck for image, @irene you for smoke, @ops-elaine monitoring, @matt triggering. Anyone else?

kai: On it.

irene: On it.

matt: I’ll ping 01:55 UTC for final go/no-go.

deploy-bot: reminder: trident-deploy in 30m (1705123500).

ops-elaine: Logged the maintenance window in the calendar and alerted customer-facing contacts.

sam: Perfect. See you all in the thread during the window — paste smoke results here. :raised_hands:
